# Heart of Texas Behavioral Health Network

> HOTBHN is a six-county Central Texas mental health authority providing 24/7 crisis support, behavioral health services, and specialized programs for children, veterans, and individuals with developmental disabilities.

Heart of Texas Behavioral Health Network (HOTBHN) has served the Central Texas region since 1968, operating across Limestone, Bosque, Falls, Hill, McLennan, and Freestone counties. The organization delivers comprehensive mental health and behavioral health services through multiple clinics and specialized centers including Klaras Center for Families and the Veterans One Stop.

## Core Services

- [Adult Behavioral Health](https://hotbhn.org/services/adult-behavioral-health): Adult behavioral health, crisis services, and psychiatric care
- [Child / Adolescent Behavioral Health](https://hotbhn.org/services/child-adolescent-behavioral-health): Child and adolescent services through Klaras Center for Families
- [Veterans Support](https://hotbhn.org/services/veterans-support): Veterans One Stop: PTSD treatment, peer support, and family services
- [Early Childhood Intervention](https://hotbhn.org/services/early-childhood-intervention): ECI services for children birth to three via Klaras Children's Center
- [Intellectual/Development Disabilities](https://hotbhn.org/services/intellectual-development-disabilities): IDD Medicaid-waiver services and eligibility information
